title: Simply eye pleasing
description: A modpack that is designed to make minecraft look as eye-pleasing as possible.
body:
This modpack is designed to make minecraft as realistic and eye-pleasing as possible.
you might encounter many visual bugs and performance stutter due to it being only in Beta state.
and if youre having visual bugs such as having 2 layers of clouds or terrain not rendering, go to distant horizons setting and turn it off or turn off clouds.
